summary: CARDS (Collector Crypt) ~$0.34, up ~18.6% in 24h. Real product news: Pump.fun launched in-app gacha packs (graded Pokemon cards, watches) powered by Collector Crypt's tokenized collectibles. But the price has already run hard, mentions are up ~1.3x, and users are already posting about losses on the packs, so much of the move looks priced in. Kept small.
